summary: Age gate leaves an orphan childless full-viewport .mpi-modal-backdrop (z-index 10009, pointer-events auto) that intercepts every click on the landing page. Found incidentally during the MPI-376 live smoke in the browser; unrelated to masking. Electron first-run impact UNKNOWN and must be checked first - the gate is accepted once per install there. Root cause not diagnosed; must be fixed at the modal/overlay teardown, never by sweeping stray backdrops.

The two age-gate fixes that DO exist predate it - f30a6ef4 2026-07-22 (MPI-333, gate chains the changelog so the backdrops stop stacking) and 3845756c 2026-06-16 (MPI-99, re-arm show after a backdrop torn down without hide). Likeliest reading: the memory is of MPI-333, and this leak survived it. Next step is the fresh-profile repro, not code reading - every teardown path reads correct statically.

If a dead landing page after CONTINUE is ever seen again, reopen and go straight to the fresh-profile repro: localStorage.removeItem('mpi_maturity_acknowledged'); location.reload() then count document.querySelectorAll('.mpi-modal-backdrop') after clicking CONTINUE.

DID NOT REPRODUCE under the exact repro this card specified - the recollection-based close now has evidence behind it. Ran the fresh-profile chain in a driven browser at 127.0.0.1:3000 with localStorage empty (no mpi_maturity_acknowledged): the 18+ gate showed, Continue set ack=true and CHAINED the changelog overlay exactly as MPI-333 intended, and dismissing that left counts of backdrops 0, wrappers 0, modals 0. A real Playwright click on the landing hero nav then SUCCEEDED with no intercepts-pointer-events retry, which is the precise failure signature this card recorded. Counts stayed balanced at 1/1/1 through the gate-to-changelog handover, so backdrops are not stacking either. ONE TRAP WORTH RECORDING, because it cost a false alarm this session: a LIVE MpiModal backdrop is legitimately childless - MpiModal.js:57-63 builds .mpi-modal-backdrop as a SEPARATE element from .mpi-modal-wrapper - so a full-viewport backdrop with children 0 and pointer-events auto describes a perfectly healthy OPEN modal just as well as an orphan. Do not diagnose an orphan from the backdrop alone: check for a sibling .mpi-modal-wrapper, and note the parent, since a live one sits inside page-landing next to its wrapper rather than directly under body. Still NOT covered: Electron first-run, which the MPI-376 handoff already flagged as unknown. This was the browser surface only.
